trap.label: put (sentidos)
trap.wrong: Put on the table. She puts off the exam for tomorrow, then pull on her coat.
trap.right: Put it on the table. She put off the exam, then put on her coat.
trap.why: Em português “vestir” e “adiar” têm verbos distintos; o brasileiro usa wear/delay ou perde o phrasal. Em inglês put on = vestir, put off = adiar, put = colocar.

fix.wrong: He puts it in the table.
fix.right: He puts it on the table.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com put on: “He wears a hat now.” (acabou de vestir)
Reescreva com put off: “We postponed the trip.”
Reescreva no passado: “She puts it on the shelf.”
rewrite.answer: She put it on the shelf.
